verdicts.reason: A pushes the CTA into a tiny, near-unreadable pill at the top left and stacks it above the two badges, so the action comes first in the reading order. A clipped circle fragment sits jammed at the left edge, and the can is shrunk to a tiny afterthought on the far right. B keeps the CTA a legible size and grouped with the badges like the original, but its body copy is cramped against the left edge on the circle and reads before the headline. The pill row also crowds the bottom edge, the large gap between can and headline looks arbitrary, and the can is tiny.
